customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be worth the money, with excellent performance and installation that goes smoothly without hassle. They appreciate its appearance, with one customer noting the modern touch panel with LED indicators, and they like the taste and quality, with one mentioning the TDS levels are below 100. The service receives positive feedback, with one customer highlighting the 2-year hassle-free warranty. However, reliability is a concern, with multiple customers reporting that the purifier stopped working within one month of use.

reviews.title: Great Water Quality & primium Product with features
reviews.body: I’m really happy with the water purifier. The water tastes clean and fresh, and the machine is working really well so far. It’s easy to use and the overall quality is good. Very satisfied with the purchase and would definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Bhushan
reviews.title: Premium Quality Purifier with Top-notch Installation Service
reviews.body: The Native M2 Pro exceeds expectations in every aspect! Excellent filtration quality, solid durability, and fantastic water flow with minimal noise level. Huge thanks to Brijesh Sir for his expert installation work. He was punctual, highly skilled, and made the whole setup completely hassle-free. Absolutely worth the buy!

reviews.author: mohammed ghiya
reviews.title: Excellent water purifier with premium features
reviews.body: I recently purchased the Native M2 Pro from Amazon and overall I’m very satisfied with the product. The design looks premium and modern, and the touch controls make dispensing water very convenient. The water purification performance has been excellent so far, and the water tastes clean and fresh. I particularly like the smart features and the Urban Company app, where you can monitor the purifier, filter status and water usage. The installation experience was also smooth.

reviews.author: Dinesh
reviews.title: Value for money and quality of water is good.
reviews.body: Product delivery took some time, but installation took place on the second day, installation process was smooth, technician done a wonderful job. Found continuous leakage from the tank after installation, same was fixed the next day by technician. Purifier is very silent, easy to setup with wifi and to connect with phone. Quality of water is good and very tasty, tds level came down to around 40-50 ppm. Got inbuilt battery just to dispense water incase of power cut, purifier doesn't run with that battery.
